+Description: target/i386: pass X86CPU to x86_cpu_get_supported_feature_word
+
+This allows modifying the bits in "-cpu max"/"-cpu host" depending on
+the guest CPU vendor (which, at least by default, is the host vendor in
+the case of KVM).
+
+For example, machine check architecture differs between Intel and AMD,
+and bits from AMD should be dropped when configuring the guest for
+an Intel model.
+
+Cc: Xiaoyao Li <xiaoyao.li@intel.com>
+Cc: John Allen <john.allen@amd.com>
+Signed-off-by: Paolo Bonzini <pbonzini@redhat.com>
+
+Origin: upstream, https://gitlab.com/qemu-project/qemu/-/commit/8dee3848
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/qemu/+bug/2131822
+Last-Update: 2025-12-16

+-uint64_t x86_cpu_get_supported_feature_word(FeatureWord w,
+-                                            bool migratable_only)
++uint64_t x86_cpu_get_supported_feature_word(X86CPU *cpu, FeatureWord w)
+ {
+     FeatureWordInfo *wi = &feature_word_info[w];
+     uint64_t r = 0;
+@@ -5852,7 +5851,7 @@ uint64_t x86_cpu_get_supported_feature_word(FeatureWord w,
+         r &= ~unavail;
+     }
+ #endif

diff --git a/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822/0001-target-i386-do-not-expose-ARCH_CAPABILITIES-on-AMD-C.patch b/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822/0001-target-i386-do-not-expose-ARCH_CAPABILITIES-on-AMD-C.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..64916d8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822/0001-target-i386-do-not-expose-ARCH_CAPABILITIES-on-AMD-C.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+Description: target/i386: do not expose ARCH_CAPABILITIES on AMD CPU
+
+KVM emulates the ARCH_CAPABILITIES on x86 for both Intel and AMD
+cpus, although the IA32_ARCH_CAPABILITIES MSR is an Intel-specific
+MSR and it makes no sense to emulate it on AMD.
+
+As a consequence, VMs created on AMD with qemu -cpu host and using
+KVM will advertise the ARCH_CAPABILITIES feature and provide the
+IA32_ARCH_CAPABILITIES MSR. This can cause issues (like Windows BSOD)
+as the guest OS might not expect this MSR to exist on such cpus (the
+AMD documentation specifies that ARCH_CAPABILITIES feature and MSR
+are not defined on the AMD architecture).
+
+A fix was proposed in KVM code, however KVM maintainers don't want to
+change this behavior that exists for 6+ years and suggest changes to be
+done in QEMU instead.  Therefore, hide the bit from "-cpu host":
+migration of -cpu host guests is only possible between identical host
+kernel and QEMU versions, therefore this is not a problematic breakage.
+
+If a future AMD machine does include the MSR, that would re-expose the
+Windows guest bug; but it would not be KVM/QEMU's problem at that
+point, as we'd be following a genuine physical CPU impl.
+
+Reported-by: Alexandre Chartre <alexandre.chartre@oracle.com>
+Suggested-by: Daniel P. Berrangé <berrange@redhat.com>
+Reviewed-by: Xiaoyao Li <xiaoyao.li@intel.com>
+Signed-off-by: Paolo Bonzini <pbonzini@redhat.com>
+
+Origin: upstream, https://gitlab.com/qemu-project/qemu/-/commit/d3a24134
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/qemu/+bug/2131822
+Last-Update: 2025-12-16
+
+---
+ target/i386/kvm/kvm.c | 6 +++++-
+ 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
+
+diff --git a/target/i386/kvm/kvm.c b/target/i386/kvm/kvm.c
+index a0bc9ea..56e1186 100644
+--- a/target/i386/kvm/kvm.c
++++ b/target/i386/kvm/kvm.c
+@@ -422,8 +422,12 @@ uint32_t kvm_arch_get_supported_cpuid(KVMState *s, uint32_t function,
+          * Linux v4.17-v4.20 incorrectly return ARCH_CAPABILITIES on SVM hosts.
+          * We can detect the bug by checking if MSR_IA32_ARCH_CAPABILITIES is
+          * returned by KVM_GET_MSR_INDEX_LIST.
++         *
++         * But also, because Windows does not like ARCH_CAPABILITIES on AMD
++         * mcahines at all, do not show the fake ARCH_CAPABILITIES MSR that
++         * KVM sets up.
+          */
+-        if (!has_msr_arch_capabs) {
++        if (!has_msr_arch_capabs || !(edx & CPUID_7_0_EDX_ARCH_CAPABILITIES)) {
+             ret &= ~CPUID_7_0_EDX_ARCH_CAPABILITIES;
+         }
+     } else if (function == 7 && index == 1 && reg == R_EAX) {
diff --git a/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822/0002-target-i386-add-compatibility-property-for-arch_capa.patch b/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822/0002-target-i386-add-compatibility-property-for-arch_capa.patch

+++ b/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822/0002-target-i386-add-compatibility-property-for-arch_capa.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,142 @@
+Description: target/i386: add compatibility property for
+ arch_capabilities
+
+Prior to v10.1, if requested by user, arch-capabilities is always on
+despite the fact that CPUID advertises it to be off/unvailable.
+This causes a migration issue for VMs that are run on a machine
+without arch-capabilities and expect this feature to be present
+on the destination host with QEMU 10.1.
+
+Add a compatibility property to restore the legacy behavior for all
+machines with version prior to 10.1.
+
+To preserve the functionality (added by 10.1) of turning off
+ARCH_CAPABILITIES where Windows does not like it, use directly
+the guest CPU vendor: x86_cpu_get_supported_feature_word is not
+KVM-specific and therefore should not necessarily use the host
+CPUID.
+
+Co-authored-by: Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>
+Signed-off-by: Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>
+Fixes: d3a24134e37 ("target/i386: do not expose ARCH_CAPABILITIES on AMD CPU", 2025-07-17)
+Signed-off-by: Paolo Bonzini <pbonzini@redhat.com>
+
+This is not a commit backport but a feature backport, in the sense that the
+same feature has been added to Noble. The feature introduces the compat
+property x-arch-cap-always-on, which is used to control the arch-caps fix.
+We do not want to enable this fix for all machine types for compatibility
+reasons.
+
+For Noble, this compat property is set to true for all machine types,
+since prior to Noble none of the machine types include the arch-caps fix.
+
+Origin: backport, https://gitlab.com/qemu-project/qemu/-/commit/e9efa4a7
+X-Backported-By: Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/qemu/+bug/2131822
+Last-Update: 2025-12-16
+
+---

+ target/i386/cpu.h     |  6 ++++++
+ target/i386/kvm/kvm.c |  2 +-
+ 4 files changed, 32 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)
+

+index 5ebb0c7..774c59a 100644
+--- a/hw/i386/pc.c
++++ b/hw/i386/pc.c
+@@ -78,7 +78,9 @@

+     { "athlon-" TYPE_X86_CPU, "model-id", "QEMU Virtual CPU version " v, },
+ 
+-GlobalProperty pc_compat_8_1[] = {};
++GlobalProperty pc_compat_8_1[] = {
++    { TYPE_X86_CPU, "x-arch-cap-always-on", "true" },
++};
+ const size_t pc_compat_8_1_len = G_N_ELEMENTS(pc_compat_8_1);
+ 
+ GlobalProperty pc_compat_8_0[] = {
+diff --git a/target/i386/cpu.c b/target/i386/cpu.c
+index 8b70e6f..f0c9e00 100644
+--- a/target/i386/cpu.c
++++ b/target/i386/cpu.c
+@@ -5813,6 +5813,7 @@ uint64_t x86_cpu_get_supported_feature_word(X86CPU *cpu, FeatureWord w)
+ {
+     FeatureWordInfo *wi = &feature_word_info[w];
+     uint64_t r = 0;
++    uint64_t unavail = 0;
+ 
+     if (kvm_enabled()) {
+         switch (wi->type) {
+@@ -5845,12 +5846,27 @@ uint64_t x86_cpu_get_supported_feature_word(X86CPU *cpu, FeatureWord w)
+          * way for userspace to get out of its 32-bit jail, we can leave
+          * the LM bit set.
+          */
+-        uint32_t unavail = tcg_enabled()
++        unavail = tcg_enabled()
+             ? CPUID_EXT2_LM & ~CPUID_EXT2_KERNEL_FEATURES
+             : CPUID_EXT2_LM;
+-        r &= ~unavail;
+     }
+ #endif
++    if (w == FEAT_7_0_EDX) {
++        /*
++         * Windows does not like ARCH_CAPABILITIES on AMD machines at all.
++         * Do not show the fake ARCH_CAPABILITIES MSR that KVM sets up,
++         * except if needed for migration.
++         *
++         * When arch_cap_always_on is removed, this tweak can move to
++         * kvm_arch_get_supported_cpuid.
++         */
++        if (cpu && IS_AMD_CPU(&cpu->env) && !cpu->arch_cap_always_on) {
++            unavail = CPUID_7_0_EDX_ARCH_CAPABILITIES;
++        }
++    }
++
++    r &= ~unavail;
++
+     if (cpu && cpu->migratable) {
+         r &= x86_cpu_get_migratable_flags(w);
+     }
+@@ -8041,6 +8057,10 @@ static Property x86_cpu_properties[] = {
+                      false),
+     DEFINE_PROP_BOOL("x-intel-pt-auto-level", X86CPU, intel_pt_auto_level,
+                      true),
++
++    DEFINE_PROP_BOOL("x-arch-cap-always-on", X86CPU,
++                     arch_cap_always_on, true),
++
+     DEFINE_PROP_END_OF_LIST()
+ };
+ 
+diff --git a/target/i386/cpu.h b/target/i386/cpu.h
+index a6a3745..456f43c 100644
+--- a/target/i386/cpu.h
++++ b/target/i386/cpu.h
+@@ -2023,6 +2023,12 @@ struct ArchCPU {
+     /* Forcefully disable KVM PV features not exposed in guest CPUIDs */
+     bool kvm_pv_enforce_cpuid;
+ 
++    /*
++     * Expose arch-capabilities unconditionally even on AMD models, for backwards
++     * compatibility with QEMU <10.1.
++     */
++    bool arch_cap_always_on;
++
+     /* Number of physical address bits supported */
+     uint32_t phys_bits;
+

+index 56e1186..67cb3d7 100644
+--- a/target/i386/kvm/kvm.c
++++ b/target/i386/kvm/kvm.c
+@@ -427,7 +427,7 @@ uint32_t kvm_arch_get_supported_cpuid(KVMState *s, uint32_t function,
+          * mcahines at all, do not show the fake ARCH_CAPABILITIES MSR that
+          * KVM sets up.
+          */
+-        if (!has_msr_arch_capabs || !(edx & CPUID_7_0_EDX_ARCH_CAPABILITIES)) {
++        if (!has_msr_arch_capabs) {
+             ret &= ~CPUID_7_0_EDX_ARCH_CAPABILITIES;
+         }
+     } else if (function == 7 && index == 1 && reg == R_EAX) {
diff --git a/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822/0003-add-noble-v2-machine-type-for-arch-caps-handling.patch b/debian/patches/ubuntu/lp2131822/0003-add-noble-v2-machine-type-for-arch-caps-handling.patch

+Description: add noble v2 machine types for arch-caps handling
+
+Across ubuntu releases before 25.10 questing we have to fix (LP: #2131822)
+the handling of arch-caps. But doing so would break existing guests, therefore
+this new behavior is gated by newly created -v2 ubuntu machine types.
+These types and handling needs to be known to subsequent releases to ensure
+they can continue to host these guests e.g. in migrations
+
+To stay as close as possible to latest upstream design, we decided to
+backport several commits that bring in the machine compat property
+arch_caps_always_on that has been added recently upstream. This compat
+property will be used to gate the new bahavior of arch_caps only on
+the newly added -v2 ubuntu machine types.
+
+Forwarded: not-needed
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/qemu/+bug/2131822
+Last-Update: 2025-12-16
+
+---
